correct_alts:
Release workflow runs on every push
- release.yml fires on any branch and burns around ninety runner minutes per day.
- It should run only for tags that match v*.
- setup-node also needs to move from Node 18 to Node 22.

Limit release.yml to version tags
The release pipeline is triggered by all pushes, costing 90 runner minutes daily. Restrict it to v* tags. While there, replace the end-of-life Node 18 with Node 22.
